# Assessment Facts Overview

Supplementary documents generated for the `eShopModernizedWebFormsSolution` assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — Architecture layers and component relationships for the Web Forms application.

- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) — Declared runtime dependencies grouped by functional area, with compatibility and test-package notes.

- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) — Page routes, image-upload contract, authentication, and application communication patterns.

- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — Catalog entities, database mapping, persistence ownership, and data sensitivity.

- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime switches, secret provisioning, and framework versions.

- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Catalog browsing, product maintenance, image upload, and associated business rules.
